main_body: two-story half-timbered and stone building with hipped tile roof
top_band: tiled roof slope from row 1 to row 42 in brown/tan tones
evidence: The building has a prominent foreshortened roof surface (rows 1-42) overhanging the two-story south wall face (rows 43-106), with eave shadows (rows 43-47) and recessed windows and door.

style.evidence: The candidate is a color-reduced, simplified edit of the Beodeul reference: the plaster walls on the upper story are large flat fills with zero speckle texture (unlike the textured plaster on the reference), the windows and sign are filled with a single flat dark tone, the roof tiles lack the multi-step per-tile highlights of the reference, and the silhouette uses a dark near-black outline.
